title: Media provider boundary
deliverable: Define bounded image/frame/audio artifacts, metadata, dimensions and deterministic decode policy.
acceptance: Pixel/frame/duration limits are checked before allocation; corrupted metadata cannot request unbounded buffers.
strict_verification: Codec/model providers expose owned resource/error contracts; dimensions/frame/tensor limits and license/asset provenance precede invocation.

title: Image decoding
deliverable: Add every required input image format and animated variant via reviewed feature-selected providers.
acceptance: Browser/native decode fixtures record color, alpha and frame semantics; unavailable codecs remain explicit gaps.
strict_verification: Every decoder bounds dimensions/pixels/frames/metadata/decompression before allocation; malformed/corrupt fixtures and actual browser memory/cancel tests pass.

title: Image encoding
deliverable: Add reference output formats, metadata policy and deterministic options where possible.
acceptance: Quality settings and byte-level nondeterminism are documented; exact output comparisons use the right compatibility criteria.
strict_verification: Each encoder freezes format/quality/color/metadata defaults with independent decoding; output/work limits and failed-publication rules hold.

title: Geometry transforms
deliverable: Add resize, crop, rotate, flip and related inventoried image operations.
acceptance: Coordinate bounds, interpolation options, orientation and very large dimensions are fixture-tested.
strict_verification: Resize/crop/rotate variants define coordinate/rounding/interpolation semantics; out-of-bounds/extreme dimensions reject before amplification.

title: Color transforms
deliverable: Add channels, grayscale, inversion, brightness/contrast and required color operations.
acceptance: Color space, alpha premultiplication and clamping rules are explicit and reproducible.
strict_verification: Color-space/channel/alpha transforms pin matrices/profiles and rounding/tolerances; independent fixtures and malformed profiles pass.

title: Filters and effects
deliverable: Add required blur/sharpen/convolution and other image effects from inventory.
acceptance: Kernel costs and edge behavior are bounded; arbitrary filter input cannot cause uncontrolled GPU/CPU allocation.
strict_verification: Each filter/effect freezes kernel/edge/tolerance semantics; oversized kernels and expensive iteration hit declared work/memory caps.

title: Image composition
deliverable: Add layering, text/annotation and inventoried composition helpers.
acceptance: Fonts/assets are local and versioned; untrusted text remains inert and export respects declared dimensions.
strict_verification: Composition bounds layers/canvas/dimensions and defines alpha/order/blending; hostile combinations cannot exceed aggregate output allocations.

title: Steganography and bit planes
deliverable: Add required image byte/bit extraction and embedding operations.
acceptance: Capacity limits, channel order and malformed payloads have round-trip and negative tests.
strict_verification: Bit-plane/steganography variants have exact embedding/extraction vectors; size/key errors reject and hidden output keeps inherited sensitivity.
